decisions.reason: As a newly launched robot that fits the firm's automation strategy and integrated precast offering, it still has significant option value and industrial customers typically need more than one year to reveal demand.

The standalone de-shuttering robot likely serves retrofit and lower-investment use cases distinct from a combined system, so the firm would keep the option open while market acceptance is still uncertain.
This more specialized storage robot is somewhat more exposed to niche demand risk, but it complements automated plant solutions and is too early in its life to abandon absent clear negative evidence.

The automatic shuttering robot strengthens the firm's modular product range for precast automation, and with growth in the industry and the firm's strong engineering base the rational choice is to continue observing the market.
